arguments.value: Cynthia M. Rufe, born in Philadelphia in 1948, has served as a United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania since 2002, when she was nominated by President George W. Bush and confirmed by the Senate. She assumed senior status in 2021. She earned her B.A. from Adelphi University in 1970 and her J.D. from the State University of New York at Buffalo Law School in 1977. Before joining the federal bench, she worked in the Bucks County Public Defender’s Office, including in the Juvenile Division, served as solicitor for the Bucks County Children and Youth Social Services Agency, practiced privately in Pennsylvania, and served as a judge of the Court of Common Pleas of Bucks County from 1994 to 2002.
